patch_resolves_note: The official patch applies cleanly and the authoritative `n132/arvo:42475209-fix` image reaches the same default-instance scaling site with `scale_uses_unrounded=0`, eliminating the vulnerable `unrounded` dereference on the staged PoC. The patched-source fixed rebuild in the reused vulnerable workspace crashed before any assertion event, so the fixed-side assertion evidence comes from the fixed-image full fallback rather than the patched-source runtime.

nodes.description: Missing default-instance guard around the scaling loop. `unrounded` is initialized only on the variation-font path, but this loop still chooses it as the source coordinate array whenever `do_scale` is true. On the witnessed default-instance component path reached during composite expansion, the loop therefore carries an indeterminate stack pointer into the dereference at the sink. The fix adds an `IS_DEFAULT_INSTANCE` split here and scales default-instance outlines from `vec` directly.

MSAN sink. The scaling loop dereferences `unrounded->x` through the indeterminate pointer carried from the default-instance component path. The staged sanitizer trace reports `MemorySanitizer: use-of-uninitialized-value` at `src/truetype/ttgload.c:1056:42` in this expression.

edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `scale_source_selection.unrounded_slot_addr == unrounded_sink.unrounded_slot_addr == 0x7ffc2f77c6f0` at ordered event indices 0 -> 1.
